title: Rotating the search leaf toward the achievable-clear direction — one exact tie, then monotone loss

x.label: cosine of the leaf's weight vector to the fitted achievable-clear direction

notes: Six arms, 64 paired whole games each on the shared evaluation cohort 0xa51d1000-0xa51d103f (reusable development data, never tuned on), depth 4, seven chance strata, corrected 17,000-point Hardcore scoring (finding-14 section 5). The popover labels carry the recorded paired delta against the frozen leaf with its one-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound (20,000 resamples, Mulberry32 domain 0xb0075eed); per-mean confidence intervals are not recorded anywhere, so no whiskers are drawn. Score is NOT strictly monotone: the smallest dose (t1-rough-560, cosine +0.181) is an exact tie at +627 (95% bound -73,325, 31-0-33) — the document's own statement is 'five metrics, six arms, one direction' with this arm the named exception; every step past it degrades monotonically to the full refit's -237,182. Along the same axis clears per move fall 2.0571 to 1.6019 (against the 2.400 conservation requirement of finding-01) and mean occupancy rises 23.15 to 28.34 cells. Negative result, evidence tier development; rejects the exact tested configurations, not a refit against remaining lifetime. Queued but never run (recorded no-run, not charted): t1-numbered and t1-solidexp-1250 at depth 4.
